title: oh.war/context/v1 (Format 1.0 section 10.3)
description: Hand-written and normative for docs/format/FORMAT-1.0.md sections 10.3 and 10.4. Where this schema and the prose disagree, the prose wins and this schema is the defect. What `war context <target> --json` emits: the same selection as the Markdown rendering, with `bytes` the size of that rendering. A record given in full (`tier: full`) carries `text`, the exact span; a record given by its summary (`tier: summary`) does not. A root (distance 0) has no `via`; every other record names the first `(step, from)` that reached it. Not expressed here, and checked by a conformance case instead: the order (distance, type rank, source, line), that `bytes` does not exceed `budget`, that the `[F]` records precede the `[S]` ones, and `selection_digest`'s value. A refusal (`context.target-unknown`, `context.over-budget`) emits no packet. Draft 3 (10.4) adds presets, additively: `preset` names the one used (`agent` when none was given), `budget` is `"none"` for a preset without one, and a preset that reads state records `journal` (`sha256:` and the first 12 hex of the journal digest) and `at` (the time it was given).

budget.description: Bytes; `--tokens n` is `4n`; default 16000; `none` for a preset without a budget (10.4).

preset.description: Section 10.4: the preset used; `agent` when none was given.

journal.description: Section 10.4: for a preset that reads state, the journal digest's first 12 hex.

at.description: Section 10.4: for a preset that reads state, the time it was given.

bytes.description: UTF-8 bytes of the Markdown rendering.

walk.description: The name of the walk used; a profile MAY declare another.

selection_digest.description: The `basis_digest` rule (section 8) over the selected records.

diagnostics.description: The prose does not give a diagnostic's shape here; it is taken to be the model's (section 8).

then.description: Section 10.3: the core walk follows its eight steps only.

step.description: A step of the walk the packet names: under `walk core`, a step of `coreStep`; under another walk (a preset's, 10.4), `in:<kind>` or `out:<kind>` of a core kind.

anyOf.description: A step a profile's preset walks (10.4).

coreStep.description: Section 10.3 step 2, in step order; then `item-intent`, step 1's placing of an item root's document `S-intent` (or, without one, the document record) at distance 1, whose `from` is the item.

title.description: The title, or for a record without one its first non-blank body line cut at 120 bytes and ended with `…` (section 10.2).

state.description: The primary state: the value of the record's state of kind `phase`, else `checklist`, else `disposition`, else `-`.
